bms_g_4168_2000062e.name: bms_i2c_frame_mode
bms_g_4168_2000062e.description: Framing mode for the I2C transfers in bms_i2c_frame_read_crc8 and bms_i2c_frame_write_crc8 (all four builds). Value 1 selects the unchecked path: up to 6 payload bytes are read or written with no CRC byte, and the routines retry four times without touching the error counter at 0x20000630. Value 0 selects CRC-8 framed transfers (polynomial 0x07, init 0, MSB first). The AFE bring-up routine bms_4168_0800aae8 sets it to 0 when it finishes, which is probably the normal mode. Other values are not handled by either routine.

bms_g_4168_20000630.name: bms_i2c_frame_error_count
bms_g_4168_20000630.description: Counter of failed CRC-checked I2C frames, kept in the range 0 to 5 (probably the link error count). bms_i2c_frame_read_crc8 and bms_i2c_frame_write_crc8 add 1 (capped at 5) when all four attempts fail, and subtract 1 (not below 0) after a good frame. bms_level_hysteresis_update reads the same byte as a level, with a threshold of 2, and sets or clears the flag at 0x2000062F from it. That flag is not in this packet, so the counter probably also serves as a link-quality level.
